stops.note: literally native of Khwarazm, the surname of the mathematician Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi, whose Arabic-language treatises introduced advanced calculation methods to the West
stops.meaning: native of Khwarazm; a mathematician's surname

stops.note: a mangled transliteration of al-Khwarizmi, entering Europe through Latin translations of Arabic mathematical texts made in Spain
carried into French for the Arabic system of calculation, later reshaped to "algorithme" by false association with Greek arithmos (number)
adopted from French algorithme for a step-by-step procedure for calculations
stops.meaning: a step-by-step procedure for solving a problem

current_meaning: a step-by-step procedure for solving a problem or performing a computation
